data.notes: Only one strong Seoul-area contemporary music event with firm May 2027 dates surfaced in current official/ticketing listings; festival and club calendars for May 2027 do not appear to be announced yet.

events.title: Bruno Mars - The Romantic Tour
events.summary: Bruno Mars brings The Romantic Tour to the Seoul area at Goyang Stadium, with Anderson .Paak appearing as DJ Pee .Wee. Official listings show the run dated May 21–30, 2027.
